standard.summary: 通过双侧 SVD 低秩投影后重构全形状梯度；基础优化器状态仍为全尺寸。这是 lulynx 工程近似，不是 GaLore 的低秩 optimizer-state 路径。
standard.effect: lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_rank 控制投影子空间维度；update_interval、warmup_steps 与 scale 控制更新频率、启用时机和重构梯度缩放。
standard.whenToUse: 把它当作实验性梯度谱过滤器，在同模型、数据和 seed 下做短程 A/B 后再决定是否保留。
standard.avoidWhen: rank 很低时不需要。投影可能丢失有用的梯度信息。

standard_en.summary: Reconstructs a full-shape gradient after a two-sided SVD low-rank projection; the base optimizer state stays full size. This is a lulynx engineering approximation, not GaLore's low-rank optimizer-state path.
standard_en.effect: lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_rank controls the projection subspace's dimension; update_interval, warmup_steps and scale control the update frequency, when it turns on, and the scaling of the reconstructed gradient.
standard_en.whenToUse: Treat it as an experimental gradient spectrum filter: run a short A/B on the same model, data and seed before deciding whether to keep it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when the rank is already very low. The projection may discard useful gradient information.

advanced.principle: 每隔 update_interval 步，对当前梯度矩阵做双侧 SVD 低秩投影，再重构回原始全形状梯度；warmup 与 scale 控制启用时机和幅度。完整 optimizer state 仍由基础优化器维护，因此不能宣称 GaLore 的显存节省。
advanced.intervention: backward 后、optimizer.step 前，将梯度乘以投影矩阵。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能改变梯度的低秩谱结构；当前不承诺显存下降、速度提升或论文等价，效果需本地 A/B。
advanced.tradeoffs: 投影基需要定期更新以适应训练动态。

advanced_en.principle: Every update_interval steps, applies a two-sided SVD low-rank projection to the current gradient matrix and reconstructs back to the original full-shape gradient; warmup and scale control when and how strongly it engages. The full optimizer state is still maintained by the base optimizer, so GaLore's VRAM savings cannot be claimed.
advanced_en.intervention: After backward and before optimizer.step, multiplies the gradient by the projection matrix.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May alter the gradient's low-rank spectral structure; currently no promise of VRAM savings, speedup, or paper equivalence — A/B locally.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The projection basis needs periodic updates to follow training dynamics.
